title: terebinthus excelsa
intro: Terebinthus excelsa, commonly known as the Aleppo pine, is a plant species native to the Mediterranean region. This evergreen tree has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate digestive issues, reduce fever, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Terebinthus excelsa include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce pain and inflammation, and act as an expectorant to relieve respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
